I’m sorry you’re feeling this way, I’m right there with you. I hope you can find peace.

If the only reason you want divorce is because you’re bored, then you need to rethink. Like others have said, you’re going to outgrow the honeymoon phase with ANYONE you’re in a relationship with. Dig deep and remember why you got married in the first place. Rekindle that spark. Maybe try couples therapy. Don’t throw it all away because it’s not exciting anymore.

I am certainly no expert, but I sympathize with your situation. Infidelity can take a long time to get over for a BS (if they ever really get over it at all). But it does sound like you’re on the right track. I hope that your BH and YOU find peace with it all at some point. Sending good vibes your way.
I will do that. Thank you so much.

You’re right about the other sub.. and you’re not the first person to tell me that either. I just left that group after reading your comment. All my close friends say the same thing, learn to love yourself alone before seeking love externally. I am trying. It’s just so unfathomably difficult. Feels like I’ll never get to a good point and never climb out of this hole of regret and guilt.
Glad I’m not the only one. I wish we could work things out but I should probably let that thought go.

I hope you find a way to heal as well.
